figurative_meaning_en: All daily routines or basic necessities (neglecting food and sleep to focus on a task)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি আহারনিদ্রা ভুলে প্রজেক্টটি শেষ করতে বসে রইলেন।
আহারনিদ্রা ছেড়ে সে পড়াশোনায় মন দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He forgot about food and sleep to finish the project.
She has abandoned food and sleep to focus on her studies.
note: Often used to express extreme dedication by forgoing basic needs like eating and sleeping
